topicA: B2B Marketing Channels and Demand Generation

recap.intro: This week you explored two areas of B2B marketing: understanding the best channels to reach businesses and how to build a strong content strategy.
bullets: Even for B2B, short videos and social media shopping tools are surprisingly effective, but traditional methods like websites and email still offer the best financial returns.
Many marketers are updating their automation tools to better track results and integrate customer data, as the industry has changed rapidly.
Managing all your online content is crucial because old information can hurt your brand, and new AI tools require a clear system to avoid "content chaos."
Beyond just numbers, understanding content success requires real conversations and turning data into compelling stories to gain support.
recap.closing: This week you learned that B2B marketing success requires adapting to new channels and technologies while strategically managing your content from creation to measurement.
